label: Compute: interest u/s 234A, 234B and 234C

params.name: assessed
params.label: assessed tax: tax on total income less TDS / TCS (s.234B Explanation 1)

params.name: adv_by
params.label: advance tax paid by 15 Jun, 15 Sep, 15 Dec and 15 Mar (by 31 Mar for the last), cumulative

params.name: adv_total
params.label: advance tax paid by 31 March

params.name: sat_total
params.label: self-assessment tax paid

params.name: sat_before_due
params.label: self-assessment tax paid by the due date

params.name: sat_im
params.label: each self-assessment payment x months from 1 April of the AY to its date, added up

params.name: sat_after_due
params.label: self-assessment tax paid after the due date (up to what was still due)

params.name: sat_after_im
params.label: each of those x months from the day after the due date to its date, added up

params.name: months_b
params.label: months from 1 April of the AY to the filing (today when not filed)

params.name: months_a
params.label: months from the day after the due date to the filing (0 when on time)

params.name: presumptive
params.label: 44AD / 44ADA: one instalment, 100% by 15 March

params.name: exempt
params.label: no advance tax at all (s.207(2): resident senior citizen with no business income) - no 234B / 234C

params.name: threshold
params.label: s.208: advance tax only when the assessed tax is 10,000 or more

params.name: rate
params.label: simple interest, % per month or part of a month

params.name: b_pct
params.label: s.234B: none when advance tax is at least 90% of the assessed tax

params.name: floor_step
params.label: Rule 119A: the amount is rounded down to a multiple of 100

params.name: pcts_normal
params.label: s.234C instalments, % of assessed tax due by each date

params.name: graces_normal
params.label: no 234C for June / September when at least 12% / 36% was paid

params.name: pcts_presumptive
params.label: 44AD / 44ADA: 100% by 15 March

params.name: c_months
params.label: months of 234C interest per instalment

description_nl: s.234C: each instalment (15/45/75/100% by 15 Jun / Sep / Dec / Mar; 44AD-ADA 100% by 15 Mar) short-paid, rounded down to 100, x 1% x 3 months (1 for March); none for June / September when 12% / 36% was paid. s.234B: when advance tax is under 90% of the assessed tax, 1% a month from 1 April on the shortfall - up to each self-assessment payment for the part it pays, up to the filing for the rest. s.234A: filed after the due date, 1% a month from the day after it on the tax still unpaid by then - up to each later self-assessment payment for the part it pays. Payments count only up to the tax due. No advance tax interest when the assessed tax is under 10,000 (s.208).
